title: Group Anagrams
hints: Two words are anagrams exactly when they have the same letter counts. Can you compute one value from a word so that anagrams, and only anagrams, produce the same value?
Comparing every pair of words is O(n^2 k). A canonical key per word turns it into a single pass over the input.
Use the sorted word (or a tuple of 26 letter counts) as a dict key and append each word to its bucket; return the buckets.
